name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a two-layer focus ring: 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring on every focusable element. This keeps the ring visible against any background while ensuring it doesn’t blend into light colors. The trade-off is a slightly larger touch target, but it improves clarity for keyboard users without sacrificing mobile usability.

name: Reader
text: The two-layer ring risks a muddy halo on patterned or dark backgrounds—#005fcc’s blue blends into dark surfaces, making the focus indicator vanish. A single 4px ring in #005fcc with a 2px white drop-shadow (box-shadow) keeps contrast sharp without adding bulk. Test it on high-contrast and dark mode mockups to confirm visibility.
